summary: Tested /contact Step 2 (Playwright desktop 1920 + mobile 390) and the backend phone 6-15 digit change (pytest). Every requested feature works: Step 2 shows all fields, the progress bar is 100% and the text reads 'Step 2 of 2'. Years run from 2027 down to 2000 (28 options). Option counts are correct: 49 makes, 12 colors, 4 acquisition, 7 budget, 6 down payment, 8 credit, 5 timeline, 3 trade-in, 6 heard-about. Model is disabled until a make is chosen. Porsche shows 7 models plus 'Other / Not listed', which reveals the custom model input. Changing make clears the model and the custom text and hides the input. Submitting empty shows the banner and the 11 required-field errors with the right messages. 'Enter the model.' and 'Let us know who sent you.' work. Picking a value clears its error. The credit hint is hidden while that field has an error and comes back after. Switching away from Friend/Referral hides and clears the referral name. Back keeps Step 1 values and clears the banner; Next restores Step 2 values. A valid submit sends no /api/lead request and does not crash. All 3 prefill URLs map correctly. Mobile has no horizontal overflow. No console errors.

minor.issue: test_public_post_evil_origin_no_acao fails. The preview ingress adds 'access-control-allow-origin: *' to every response. The backend itself (localhost:8001) sends no ACAO header for evil.com, so this is the preview platform, not the app. Not actionable in app code.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX: changeMake calls setField('vehicleModel', ''), and setField deletes that key's error. So after a failed submit, choosing a make removes the 'Select a model.' error even though the model is still empty. It reappears on the next submit. Acceptable.

The Step 2 valid-submit branch is a no-op by design (submission is not wired yet). Next iteration: map vehicleModel 'Other / Not listed' to vehicleModelCustom in the payload, because the backend has no vehicleModelCustom field and extra fields are ignored.

success_rate.backend: 98% (56/57; the 1 failure is from the preview ingress)
